0022600109.text: The Dallas Mavericks (1-1, third in the Southwest and ninth in the West) host the San Antonio Spurs (0-2, fifth in the Southwest and 12th in the West) in the third game of Dallas's season, and the Mavericks come in on a one-game winning streak. Dallas is without Cooper Flagg (out, shoulder soreness; 23.0 points and 24.9 minutes per game this season) and Dereck Lively II (out, foot surgery), and Caleb Martin, Jett Howard, Santi Aldama and Tarik Biberovic are day-to-day with game-time decisions. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (out, knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (out, calf strain), and the 2026-27 season series has no games yet, though the Mavericks lost 0-4 in the 2025-26 series, including a 139-120 loss in San Antonio on April 10.
